69: def numeric(block):
70:     result = {}
71:     for key, value in re.findall(r"^\s*(\w+)\s*=\s*(\d+)\s*$", block, re.M):
72:         if key in result:
73:             require(not key.startswith(("DTC_", "gpu_", "gpgpu_n_mem_", "icnt_total_")),
74:                     "duplicate_numeric_metric:" + key)
75:         result[key] = int(value)
76:     return result

79: def traffic(block):
80:     buckets = {}
81:     for kind, outcome, value in re.findall(
82:             r"^\s*L2_cache_stats_breakdown\[(\w+)\]\[(\w+)\]\s*=\s*(\d+)\s*$", block, re.M):
83:         key = kind + ":" + outcome
84:         require(key not in buckets, "duplicate_L2_bucket")
85:         buckets[key] = int(value)
86:     dram = re.findall(r"^DRAM\[(\d+)\]:[^\n]*\n(n_cmd=[^\n]+)", block, re.M)
87:     require(len(dram) == 20 and {int(i) for i, _ in dram} == set(range(20)),
88:             "DRAM_population_20_controllers")
89:     controllers = {}
90:     for index, line in dram:
91:         entries = re.findall(r"(n_cmd|n_nop|n_act|n_pre|n_req|n_rd|n_rd_L2_A|n_write|n_wr_bk)=(\d+)", line)
92:         row = {key: int(value) for key, value in entries}
93:         require(len(row) == len(entries), "duplicate_DRAM_field")
94:         controllers[str(int(index))] = row
95:     reads = sum(buckets["GLOBAL_ACC_R:" + key] for key in
96:                 ("HIT", "HIT_RESERVED", "MISS", "SECTOR_MISS"))
97:     require(reads == buckets["GLOBAL_ACC_R:TOTAL_ACCESS"], "L2_accepted_read_bucket_partition")
98:     rd = sum(row["n_rd"] + row["n_rd_L2_A"] for row in controllers.values())
99:     wr = sum(row["n_write"] + row["n_wr_bk"] for row in controllers.values())
100:     return dict(L2_buckets=buckets, L2_accepted_read_32B_sectors=reads,
101:                 L2_read_payload_bytes=32 * reads, DRAM_controllers=controllers,
102:                 DRAM_atom_bytes=32, DRAM_issued_read_atoms=rd, DRAM_issued_write_atoms=wr,
103:                 DRAM_read_payload_bytes=32 * rd, DRAM_write_payload_bytes=32 * wr,
104:                 DRAM_n_ref_event="UNAVAILABLE_INHERITED_UNINITIALIZED_FIELD_RAW_PRESERVED")
